_doc: Every picture the default UI shows for the demo cast, the demo story and the example tiles comes from this file, so the image choices can be swapped in one place (Lumi's design may change on Oct 20). Only review-passed sources may be listed; a slot set to null shows the stylised placeholder or the move's glyph card. 'source' and 'verdict' record where each file came from (copied, never edited in place). Display only: generation still uses each character's own pack.
film_rules: Lumi's ears are subtle or hidden, never big pointed elf ears.
Lumi's prop is the cream sketchbook, never the red hardcover book.

lumi-night-shift.approved_takes_why: Allow-list per shot beat. An entry is a stored take id ("v9") or a shipped take {id, video, poster} served from assets/ (the demo story's data is never written). Takes not listed are kept on disk but show 'No approved take yet'.
lumi-night-shift.hide_takes_before_why: Takes that existed at the visual review's 22:31 check (cat, ear tips, red book) and the seeded concept stills stay hidden unless listed above; takes a user makes afterwards show as usual (the Review copy promises that). Approved in content review, Oct 18 2026 23:37.

Cold open.prompt: 3 AM, rain on the window. Lumi slouches behind the register, chin on her hand, doodling in her cream sketchbook.
replaces: 3 AM, rain on the convenience-store window. Lumi, bored at the register, reads an ancient book; a ginger cat sleeps on the counter.

Doors chime.prompt: The door chimes. Mio and Ren stumble in arm in arm, laughing and shaking off the rain. Lumi doesn't look up.
replaces: The door chimes. Mio and Ren, a tipsy young couple, stumble in out of the rain, laughing.

Canned coffee.prompt: Ren holds up a plain slim steel can of coffee (no colors, no logos) from the fridge like a trophy and sets it on the counter. Lumi closes her sketchbook and looks from the plain slim steel can to them, eyes off camera.
replaces: Ren holds up a canned coffee from the fridge like a trophy and sets it on the counter. Lumi closes her sketchbook and looks from the can to them.
Ren grabs a canned coffee from the fridge and sets it on the counter; Lumi judges him silently.
Canned coffee.source: production/script/SCRIPT_v3.md (SCRIPT_v3 §3 The can + §4 The verdict), read only

Real coffee.prompt: “Give me three minutes.” Lumi makes two pour-over coffees, slowly and seriously, and slides the paper cups across the counter.
replaces: Lumi takes the can away and makes them real coffee with whole milk, slowly and seriously.
Real coffee.source: production/script/SCRIPT_v3.md (SCRIPT_v3 §5 Three minutes + §6 Pour-over), read only

Sip and freeze.prompt: Mio and Ren lean in, suspicious, and sip. Their eyes go wide. Lumi glances at the plain slim steel can. Says nothing.
replaces: Mio and Ren lean in, suspicious, and sip. Their eyes go wide.
Mio and Ren sip. They freeze. Lumi, deadpan, holds her own cup.
Mio and Ren lean in, suspicious, and sip. Their eyes go wide. Lumi glances at the can and says nothing.
Sip and freeze.source: production/script/SCRIPT_v3.md (SCRIPT_v3 §7 Real coffee + §8 (the sip)), read only

Into the rain.prompt: They wave and stumble back out into the rain. The door closes. Lumi, alone: “See you sometime later.”
replaces: Mio and Ren leave and wave back at her as they step into the rain.

Daydream.prompt: Back to doodling. A slow push into the page: the drawing comes alive in warm colored pencil, the three of them as fantasy adventurers on a sunset road, cups raised.
replaces: Daydream: the three of them on a fantasy adventure, painterly anime style.
Back to doodling. A slow push into the page: the drawing comes alive in warm colored pencil, the three of them as fantasy adventurers on a sunset road, cups raised.

Back to doodling. A slow push into the page: the drawing comes alive in warm colored pencil, the three of them as fantasy adventurers on a sunset road, cups raised. Lumi's ears stay hidden under her hood.

Ending.prompt: She closes the sketchbook and looks out at the rain with a tiny smile.
replaces: After they leave, she opens her ancient book: it holds fun moments she remembers, each drawn anime-style as a fantasy adventure (a fishing trip drawn as a dragon hunt, a 1980s arcade night drawn as a dungeon raid). She draws tonight's tipsy coffee run with the couple as a new quest, closes the book softly, and the cat looks at the camera.
She closes the sketchbook and looks out at the rain with a tiny smile. End card: Lumi – Night Shift.
Ending.end_card: The 'Lumi – Night Shift' end card is set in type in the edit (ffmpeg drawtext on black), never generated, so it stays out of the render text.

lumi-night-shift.shot_text_why: The audited film has no cat and no ancient book (she doodles in a cream sketchbook). Shown instead of the stored description only while the stored text is still one of 'replaces', so a user's own edit always wins; the stored data is never written. Renders from these shots use the new text too.
